projected_gramian.basis: orthonormal real Fourier modes k=1..10 for u and q

notes: The first exploratory gradient-validation label 'mostly_unsaturated' was imprecise: rate saturation was active in all time steps. Refined checks below explicitly distinguish fully unsaturated from rate-saturated controls.
Projected Gramian is computed for the unbounded linearized system along the zero-control reference trajectory; pointwise amplitude/rate constraints are not encoded in its eigenvalues.
Gramian eigenvalue effort proxy 1/sqrt(lambda) is relative/local for unit active-state displacement, not a thermodynamic cost or proof of infinite force.
